## Part 2.5: Finish annotation

If we did not run `03_saha_markers.R` on Day 1, run the following optional chunks first. They are skipped when knitting; otherwise continue directly to **Resume SAHA**.

### Load packages and checkpoint

```{r optional_markers_1, eval=FALSE}
# Part 2.5: begin SAHA annotation at resolution 0.1.
# Start here near the end of Day 1, or at the beginning of Day 2.

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(qs2)
library(SAHA)
library(SAHAdata)

obj <- qs_read(file = "./results/day1/02_integrated.qs2")
```

### Marker-based annotation

Begin at resolution 0.1 and compare cluster markers with the Allen reference.

```{r optional_markers_2, eval=FALSE}
Idents(obj) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.1"
# saha_inputs<- Seurat2SAHA(obj)#if you need to
saha_inputs<-qs_read(file = "results/day2/annotation/03_inputs_res01.qs2")#this should have been from yesterday  

# Allen ISOCTX is an annotation aid. Review label validity for each tissue.
data("ISOCTX_Markers", package = "SAHAdata")
data("ABC_meta", package = "SAHAdata")
ann <- SAHA::Create_SAHA_object(
  query = saha_inputs$markers, db = ISOCTX_Markers, data_type = "Markers"
)
ann <- SAHA::Initialize_Markers(ann)
ann <- SAHA::Run_Marker_Based(ann)
ann <- SAHA::Create_MarkerBased_Viz(ann, meta = ABC_meta)
auto <- SAHA::AutoAnnotate(ann, data_type = "Markers")
print(auto)

print(ann@results$marker_based$dotplot_all)

# Stop here if we have reached the end of Day 1.
# qs_save(ann, file = "results/day2/annotation/03_markers_res01.qs2")
```

### Resume SAHA

Matching script: `scripts/04_saha_annotate.R`. Read the saved inputs and marker-based object, add marker-free annotation, and repeat at resolution 0.5. The final object uses the resolution 0.5 labels; resolution 0.1 labels are retained in `anno_subclass_res01` and `anno_class_res01`.

### Load packages and checkpoint

```{r saha_finish_1}
# Part 2.5: resume SAHA, finish resolution 0.1, then repeat at resolution 0.5.

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(qs2)
library(SAHA)
library(SAHAdata)

obj <- qs_read("results/day1/02_integrated.qs2")
saha_inputs <- qs_read("results/day2/annotation/03_inputs_res01.qs2")
ann <- qs_read("results/day2/annotation/03_markers_res01.qs2")
data("ABC_meta", package = "SAHAdata")
```

### Marker-free annotation

Resume from the saved marker-based SAHA object and add average expression.

```{r saha_finish_2}
data("ISOCTX_AvgExp", package = "SAHAdata")
ann <- SAHA::Create_SAHA_object(
  query = saha_inputs$avgexp, db = ISOCTX_AvgExp, data_type = "AvgExp",existing = ann
)
ann=Initialize_MarkerFree(ann = ann)
ann=Downsample(ann,custom_ds = saha_inputs$varfeat)
ann=NormalizeDS(ann,assay_query = "RNA")
ann=CorrelateDS(ann)
ann=Create_MarkerFree_Viz(ann,meta = ABC_meta)
call_SAHA_plots(ann, plot_type = "Marker-free",data_type = "AvgExp")

auto=AutoAnnotate(ann,data_type = "Both")
auto

ann <- Summarize_Params(ann)  # Run the function
ann@params$summary

Generate_SAHA_Report(ann, auto = auto, output_file = "./results/day2/annotation/saha_res01.html")

glimpse(obj@meta.data)
glimpse(auto)
glimpse(ABC_meta)
```

### Add the labels

Match cluster labels back to the Seurat metadata.

```{r saha_finish_3}
# Match auto clusters to the resolution 0.1 clustering.
obj$anno_subclass <- auto$marker_free[
  match(as.character(obj$RNA_snn_res.0.1), auto$cluster)
]

obj$anno_class <- ABC_meta$class[
  match(obj$anno_subclass, ABC_meta$subclass_spa)
]

DimPlot(obj,reduction = "umap_harmony",group.by = "anno_class")
DimPlot(obj,reduction = "umap_harmony",group.by = "anno_subclass")

obj$anno_subclass_res01 <- obj$anno_subclass
obj$anno_class_res01 <- obj$anno_class
```

### Repeat at resolution 0.5

Repeat the same annotation workflow with the finer clustering.

```{r saha_finish_4}
##################do all over again....
Idents(obj) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.5"
saha_inputs<- Seurat2SAHA(obj)
qs_save(saha_inputs, file = "results/day2/annotation/03_inputs_res05.qs2")  

# Allen ISOCTX is an annotation aid. Review label validity for each tissue.
data("ISOCTX_Markers", package = "SAHAdata")
data("ABC_meta", package = "SAHAdata")
ann <- SAHA::Create_SAHA_object(
  query = saha_inputs$markers, db = ISOCTX_Markers, data_type = "Markers"
)
ann <- SAHA::Initialize_Markers(ann)
ann <- SAHA::Run_Marker_Based(ann)
ann <- SAHA::Create_MarkerBased_Viz(ann, meta = ABC_meta)
auto <- SAHA::AutoAnnotate(ann, data_type = "Markers")
print(auto)

print(ann@results$marker_based$dotplot_all)

data("ISOCTX_AvgExp", package = "SAHAdata")
ann <- SAHA::Create_SAHA_object(
  query = saha_inputs$avgexp, db = ISOCTX_AvgExp, data_type = "AvgExp",existing = ann
)
ann=Initialize_MarkerFree(ann = ann)
ann=Downsample(ann,custom_ds = saha_inputs$varfeat)
ann=NormalizeDS(ann,assay_query = "RNA")
ann=CorrelateDS(ann)
ann=Create_MarkerFree_Viz(ann,meta = ABC_meta)
call_SAHA_plots(ann, plot_type = "Marker-free",data_type = "AvgExp")

auto=AutoAnnotate(ann,data_type = "Both")
auto

ann <- Summarize_Params(ann)  # Run the function
ann@params$summary

Generate_SAHA_Report(ann, auto = auto, output_file = "./results/day2/annotation/saha_res05.html")

glimpse(obj@meta.data)
glimpse(auto)
glimpse(ABC_meta)

# Match auto clusters to the resolution 0.5 clustering.
obj$anno_subclass <- auto$marker_free[
  match(as.character(obj$RNA_snn_res.0.5), auto$cluster)
]

obj$anno_class <- ABC_meta$class[
  match(obj$anno_subclass, ABC_meta$subclass_spa)
]

DimPlot(obj,reduction = "umap_harmony",group.by = "anno_class")
DimPlot(obj,reduction = "umap_harmony",group.by = "anno_subclass")

qs_save(obj,"./results/day2/annotation/04_annotated.qs2")
```

## Part 3: Differential expression

Matching script: `scripts/05_de.R`. Read `04_annotated.qs2`, subset microglia, and compare the cell-level and sample-level approaches. These unmatched samples are for the teaching comparison; study and condition are confounded.

### Load packages and checkpoint

```{r de_1}
# Part 3: compare MAST cell-level DE with edgeR sample-level pseudobulk.
# These five unmatched samples cannot identify a 5xFAD disease effect.
# Run: Rscript scripts/05_de.R

library(Seurat)
library(MAST)
library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(qs2)
library(patchwork)

project_dir <- "."
result_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results/day2/de")
plot_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "plots/day2")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

obj<-qs_read("./results/day2/annotation/04_annotated.qs2")
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
```

### Subset microglia

Use the completed annotation and inspect the samples contributing microglia.

```{r de_2}
micro_cells <- rownames(obj@meta.data)[!is.na(obj$anno_subclass) & obj$anno_subclass == "334 Microglia NN"]

micro <- base::subset(obj, cells = micro_cells)

sample_info <- micro@meta.data |>
  dplyr::count(sample_id, study, condition, name = "n_microglia")

print(sample_info)
```

### Cell-level MAST

Compare 5xFAD with reference cells using the supplied cell-level model.

```{r de_3}
# MAST fits cell-level tests: cells from a sample are not independent replicates.
# The resulting p-values are not valid evidence of a disease association here.
Idents(micro) <- "condition"
mast_results <- Seurat::FindMarkers(
  object = micro, ident.1 = "5xFAD", ident.2 = "reference",
  assay = "RNA", test.use = "MAST", latent.vars = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
  logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.2# logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.1 #to speed up the demonstration inc logfc and min.pct
)
mast_results <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(mast_results), var = "gene")
# utils::write.csv(mast_results,
#                  file.path(result_dir, "teaching_only_MAST_microglia.csv"),
#                  row.names = FALSE)
```

### Sample-level pseudobulk

Sum raw counts per sample and run the supplied edgeR model.

```{r de_4}
# Aggregate raw counts per biological sample; never aggregate per condition only.
# The s prefix avoids Seurat renaming a group that starts with a digit.
micro$sample_key <- paste0("s", match(micro$sample_id, sample_info$sample_id))
sample_info$sample_key <- paste0("s", seq_len(nrow(sample_info)))
pbulk_counts <- Seurat::AggregateExpression(
  micro, assays = "RNA", group.by = "sample_key", return.seurat = FALSE
)[["RNA"]]
pbulk_info <- sample_info[match(colnames(pbulk_counts), sample_info$sample_key), ]

group <- factor(pbulk_info$condition, levels = c("reference", "5xFAD"))
design <- stats::model.matrix(~ group)
pbulk_info <- as.data.frame(pbulk_info)
rownames(pbulk_info) <- pbulk_info$sample_key
y <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = pbulk_counts, samples = as.data.frame(pbulk_info))
keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(y, design = design)
summary(keep)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)
y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(y, design)
qlf <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "group5xFAD")
pbulk_results <- edgeR::topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene")

# utils::write.csv(pbulk_results,
#                  file.path(result_dir, "teaching_only_edgeR_pseudobulk_microglia.csv"),
#                  row.names = FALSE)


# Save both methods so the comparison can start in a fresh R session.
qs_save(list(mast = mast_results, pseudobulk = pbulk_results,
             counts = pbulk_counts, samples = pbulk_info),
        file.path(result_dir, "05_de.qs2"))
```

## Part 3: Compare the methods

Matching script: `scripts/06_compare.R`. Read `05_de.qs2` and reproduce the comparison plots.

### Load packages and checkpoint

```{r comparison_1}
# Part 3: compare cell-level MAST with sample-level pseudobulk results.
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(qs2)

result_dir <- "results/day2/de"
plot_dir <- "plots/day2"
de <- qs_read(file.path(result_dir, "05_de.qs2"))
mast_results <- de$mast
pbulk_results <- de$pseudobulk
```

### Compare the methods

Resume from the saved DE results and reproduce the slide comparisons.

```{r comparison_2}
######################################
# Resume Here
######################################
comparison <- dplyr::full_join(
  mast_results %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, mast_log2FC = avg_log2FC, mast_p = p_val_adj),
  pbulk_results %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, pbulk_log2FC = logFC, pbulk_FDR = FDR),
  by = "gene"
)
# utils::write.csv(comparison,
#                  file.path(result_dir, "teaching_only_method_comparison.csv"),
#                  row.names = FALSE)


volc1<-ggplot(comparison,aes(x = mast_log2FC,y = -log10(mast_p)))+geom_point()+theme_linedraw()
volc2<-ggplot(comparison,aes(x = pbulk_log2FC,y = -log10(pbulk_FDR)))+geom_point()+theme_linedraw()
volc1|volc2

plot(
  eulerr::euler(list(mast = mast_results$gene, pbulk = pbulk_results$gene)),
  quantities = TRUE
)

figure <- ggplot2::ggplot(comparison,
                          ggplot2::aes(x = mast_log2FC, y = pbulk_log2FC)) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey75") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "MAST cell-level log2 fold change",
                y = "edgeR sample-level log2 fold change") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic()
# grDevices::png(file.path(plot_dir, "03_mast_vs_pseudobulk.png"),
#                width = 7, height = 6, units = "in", res = 160)
print(figure)

figure2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(comparison,
                          ggplot2::aes(x = -log10(mast_p), y = -log10(pbulk_FDR))) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75") +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey75") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "MAST cell-level -log10(p)",
               y = "edgeR sample-level -log10(FDR)") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic()
# grDevices::png(file.path(plot_dir, "03_mast_vs_pseudobulk.png"),
#                width = 7, height = 6, units = "in", res = 160)
print(figure2)
# grDevices::dev.off()

message("Finished teaching-only comparison; do not interpret p-values as disease effects.")
```
